items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Fever assistant coach Austin Kelly, who runs the offense, is not on the bench in Toronto.

His wife (and fellow assistant coach), Karima Christmas-Kelly, is already on maternity leave.

So Gary Kloppenburg moved to the front of the bench, joining January and Bevilaqua.

items.title: A billionaire can write off a private jet as a business expense, but a teacher can't write off the crayons she bought for her classroom.
items.author: Mark Jones
items.body_excerpt:
A billionaire can write off a private jet as a business expense, but a teacher can't write off the crayons she bought for her classroom.

A CEO can deduct a $500 steak dinner, but a nurse can't deduct the scrubs she's required to wear.

Tax code might be upside down. 

Priorities man 🤦🏽‍♂️
